status_meaning: Proposal only. It is NOT a pre-registration and binds nothing until the project owner edits it as needed, sets 'registered' and 'decided_by', and freezes it under hallthruster_bridge/prereg/ (the owner's step; this file deliberately lives outside that folder). Until then no O/O2 verdict may be computed under it.
must_be_frozen_before: any O/O2 rate table is built, any O/O2 reaction enters a propellant configuration, any O/O2 rate or cross section is compared with another (beyond the existence/coverage audit in o_o2_source_matrix_v1.json), and any Hall run containing O or O2 is made or scored
disclosure: Drafted after a literature/source audit only (o_o2_source_matrix_v1.json). No O/O2 rate coefficient, F_P, F_ion or F_S value has been computed, and no O/O2 Hall run exists. The N2 audit outcomes (hallthruster_bridge/audit/) were known to the drafter; the thresholds below are copied from the N2 rule, not chosen from any O/O2 number.
gating: CLAUDE.md 'Next work' item 4: O2/O chemistry only if items 1-3 succeed. Freezing this rule does not authorize implementation; it only fixes the completeness criteria in advance.
purpose: Decide which electron-impact processes must be added to an O/O2 reaction set before it may be called complete for a stated use. Evaluated from cross sections and rate coefficients (and, for F_S, from a pre-declared state envelope), without reference to any fit quality or validation outcome.

not_proposed: metastable O(1D), O(1S), O2(a1Delta_g), O2(b1Sigma_g+) as tracked species (explicit omission; row OO2-25)

default.basis: The N2 upper limit came from its tightest verified table (dissociation_N2, 45 eV mean energy). For O/O2 the tightest limit is not known until tables are built and their tail shares computed (candidates: O data end at 200 eV per SONG2026; O2 electronic excitation theory is plotted only to 20 eV). Owner decision OD-1: keep 2-30 eV and treat states beyond a verified table limit as outside the domain (as for N2), or set the limit after the validity audit.

low_energy_channels.basis: Mirrors the N2 vibrational/rotational window; these channels have thresholds near or below 2 eV (a: 0.98 eV, b: 1.63 eV per SONG2026).

fractions.F_P: k_omit(Te) dE_omit / sum_j k_j(Te) dE_j: share of total electron inelastic power (same definition as N2)
fractions.F_ion: nu_ions,omit k_omit(Te) / sum_j nu_ions,j k_j(Te): share of total positive-ion production (ionizing channels only; same definition as N2)
fractions.F_S_s: share of the production or destruction of a particular modeled species s due to the omitted channel (same definition as N2)
fractions.F_att_PROPOSED: k_att(Te) n_O2 / sum_j nu_ions,j k_j(Te) n_j: electron loss by attachment relative to electron production by ionization. Not in the N2 rule (N2 has no attachment channel); inclusion and threshold are owner decision OD-5.

thresholds.F_att_PROPOSED: TBD - owner decision OD-5 (the drafter's suggestion is to mirror F_ion, 0.01; not adopted)
thresholds.basis: Copied from n2_completeness_audit_v1 so that both reaction sets are judged by one standard; no O/O2 number was consulted.

rule: Promote the omitted process if F_P > 0.01 OR F_ion > 0.01 OR F_S_s > 0.05 anywhere in its applicable Te domain (identical to the N2 rule).

ambiguity_rule_PROPOSED_ADOPTION.bounds_over: all evaluated nuisance choices (composition grid, chemistry variant, and, if a state envelope is used, operating point and transport candidate)
ambiguity_rule_PROPOSED_ADOPTION.robustness: If a verdict changes with a nuisance choice, the uncertainty belongs in the validation set (between-bounds case).

crosscheck_rule_PROPOSED_ADOPTION.rule: Earlier and later evaluation sets are an implementation-consistency check only; the newest set carrying the full metric list is authoritative; sets are never averaged; any discrepancy that could alter a verdict is resolved before the rule is applied. Verdicts applied literally, no judgment adjustment near a threshold.

denominators: Sum over the best currently available complete set of included processes. Any evaluation made before every tier-1 process exists as a verified table is PROVISIONAL and must be repeated once they are in place (same as N2).

options: rate-coefficient-only evaluation over a pre-declared grid of composition ratios (n_O/n_O2, n_ion/n_neutral), as the provisional N2 dissociative-ionization audit did
a blind state envelope from Hall runs with measured targets removed, as the N2 tier-3 closure did
state_basis_for_F_S.requirement: Whichever is chosen, the composition grid (or run design) must be fixed here before any value is computed. It must cover the intake-delivered composition range given by the frozen atmosphere + intake model; the ranges are not stated in this draft (TBD - requires a sourced extraction from abep_sim's frozen datasets, which this lane did not perform).

1_required_before_any_scoring: O electronic excitation: state list OWNER DECISION OD-3; drafter's candidate list = 2p4 1D, 2p4 1S, 3s 5S, 3s 3S and the allowed 3D transition of SONG2026 Fig. 25 (caption: 3s 3D; plot label: 3d 3D; verify which) - the transitions SONG2026 singles out in Figs. 25-26 - with the remaining BSR-1116 transitions assessed as one lumped omitted process under F_P (OO2-03)
O2 dissociative ionization O2 -> O+ + O, with the O+/O2^2+ column ambiguity carried as upper/lower variants if a published O2^2+ estimate is adopted (OO2-06)
O2 dissociation into neutrals, with the accounting against dissociative electronic excitation fixed by OWNER DECISION OD-4 (OO2-08)
O2 electronic excitation a1Delta_g, b1Sigma_g+ and the Herzberg states c, A', A, with the extension above the R-matrix range fixed by OWNER DECISION OD-6 (OO2-10, OO2-11, OO2-13)
2_assess_before_complete: O2 B3Sigma_u- (Schumann-Runge) and higher electronic states (OO2-12)
O2+ dissociative excitation e + O2+ -> O+ + O + e (OO2-19)
O2 dissociative electron attachment -> O- (OO2-16), assessed under F_att only if OD-5 admits O-
3_assessed_not_included_unless_bound_exc: O2 rotational excitation (OO2-15; gross vs net convention fixed here before any bound is seen: OWNER DECISION OD-7)
O+ -> O^2+ (OO2-17; energy link, required if any O^2+ channel is promoted)
O^2+ -> O^3+ (BELL1983 O III; bound only)

items: O- sinks: electron-impact detachment (OO2-22), associative detachment and mutual neutralization (OO2-23)
heavy-particle chemistry (charge exchange, ion-molecule reactions, NO formation) and all surface processes
outside_this_rule.note: The F_P / F_ion / F_S rule is written for electron-impact channels. Volume recombination and negative-ion chemistry need their own relevance criterion (OWNER DECISION OD-5, OD-8) before they can be excluded or promoted. Listing them here records the omission; it does not assert they are negligible.

preconditions_before_freezing: Obtain and hash the SONG2026 version of record or its supplementary datasets and re-check every value the tier-1 tables will use (the audit read only the accepted manuscript).
Resolve CC-2 of the source matrix: confirm whether the installed HallThruster tree equals the pinned commit, and decide how its uncited negative-ion constants are handled if O- is ever admitted.
Record in PINNED.toml a separate reaction-set label for O/O2 (the N2 label abep-n2n-* must never refer to a set containing O/O2).

owner_decisions_required.OD-1: Domain upper limit (keep T_e 2-30 eV, or set after the O/O2 validity audit).
owner_decisions_required.OD-2: State basis for F_S (composition grid vs blind state envelope) and the grid itself.
owner_decisions_required.OD-3: O excitation: individual states vs lumped remainder; header energies from a cited level list.
owner_decisions_required.OD-4: O2 dissociation vs dissociative electronic excitation accounting (double counting, sub-13.5 eV coverage, representative energy loss).
owner_decisions_required.OD-5: Whether O- is admitted at all; if so, the F_att metric and threshold, and sourced O- sinks before any run.
owner_decisions_required.OD-6: Extension of O2 electronic excitation above the R-matrix range (the N2 precedent used measured data from 20 eV plus a power-law continuation).
owner_decisions_required.OD-7: Rotational excitation convention (gross vs net) fixed before any bound is computed.
owner_decisions_required.OD-8: Relevance criterion for volume recombination (O2+ DR, O+ radiative) versus wall loss.

status_rule: A future O/O2 reaction-set status stays INCOMPLETE until every tier-2 and tier-3 process has a final (non-provisional) verdict under the frozen version of this rule, and every tier-1 process exists as a verified table.
no_claims: This draft makes no claim about O/O2 chemistry completeness, Hall performance, ABEP closure, architecture choice or transport admission.
